nodes.name: Run the recovery sweep
nodes.notes: POST /api/automation/recovery/sweep. Up to 60 s: a sweep may retry a few AI qualifications.

nodes.name: Check: Run the recovery sweep
nodes.notes: 2xx → continue. Other answers fail the run: TEMPORARY (5xx, 408, 429) or PERMANENT (4xx, not retried).

nodes.name: Did the sweep work?
nodes.notes: Fails the run if the Recovery Agent reported a failure.
